catalogDescription: Each agent is an AI operator you set up once by describing your business. You stay in charge of what it may do.
installFailed: Could not set up this agent
earlyHint: Early access: the agent works through its setup chat and Authority rules; its workbench is still being built.
workbenchBody: The working screen of this agent is not ready yet. You can already set it up in the Setup tab and choose what it may do alone on the Authority page.
filterSearchPlaceholder: Search by name, description or category
emptyHint: Try another word, or clear the filters to see every agent.
displayNameHint: What your team sees in Office and on cards.
modeAssistHelp: The agent prepares work and always asks you before it acts.
modeAutopilotHelp: The agent works by the permissions you set on the Authority page; your rules and limits stay as they are.
modeNote: Switching mode never edits the rules on the Authority page; Assist only makes the AI ask first until you switch back.
liveHelp: When live, the agent acts on your channels. When paused, it stays silent.
shiftsBindChannel: Attach a Telegram/Zalo channel to notify staff of their shifts
liveNeedsVersion: Apply a setup version first: the agent needs your confirmed context before it can go live.
instancesDescription: Each {type} has its own name, channels, knowledge and setup. Authority rules are shared by every {type}.
instanceAddDescription: Name it so your team can tell it apart, for example after the branch, brand or Fanpage it serves.
instanceNameHint: Up to 80 characters, different from your other {type} agents.
instanceNameInvalid: The name must be 1 to 80 characters.
instanceNameTaken: Another agent of this type already has that name.
instanceSingleOnly: This agent type is installed once per workspace.
instanceNameSettingsHint: Shown in the agent list, the header and Office, e.g. "Chatbot – Q1 branch".
authorityShared: Authority rules apply to every {type} agent of this workspace: they are set per agent type on the Authority page, not per branch or page.
grantHint: Each connection this agent can work through, with how far it may go. The same setting as the Agents button on the Connections page.
grantEmpty: No connection of a suitable type yet.
grantOwnerOnly: Only the workspace owner changes an agent's access.
grantPurpose_lead_source: Receives the leads of your lead ads
syncDrift: Out of step: Supabase v{active}, OpenClaw v{synced}
syncOkNone: OpenClaw copy: no context version yet · {ago}
syncHelp: The agent runs on OpenClaw from a copy of your setup, rules and knowledge. It follows what you approved here, and updates itself every 5 minutes.
timeoutHint: If the agent has not answered by then, the customer gets a direct answer instead (5 to 120, default 25).
holdingHint: What a customer gets when the agent cannot answer in time. A person is then asked to reply. Leave empty for the default.
holdingDefault: Dạ em đã nhận tin, nhân viên sẽ phản hồi anh/chị sớm ạ
autoHelp: Jobs that run by themselves for this agent. Switch each one on or off.
